actions: Treat this run as evidence of limited signal, not a usable model.
Require cleaning and a stronger modeling cycle before any formal report.
reasons: Best model improves accuracy by only about 0.029 over the dummy baseline.
Duplicate rows remain untreated in the modeling input.
The feature set is still the raw all-non-target set rather than an agent-reviewed modeling set.
No tuning, threshold analysis, calibration, or cost-sensitive evaluation has been performed.
summary: Do not continue to reporting. The model shows some signal, but the uplift over baseline is too small for business usefulness, and the pipeline has not yet applied de-duplication, deliberate feature selection, or tuning.
